title: Plugin hooks' enabled=false kill switch is inoperative for unquoted TOML

description:
## What

The `enabled = false` kill switch documented for the Claude Code plugin's
session hooks does not work. `read_plugin_config` in both
`plugin/claude-code/hooks/post-git.sh` and
`plugin/claude-code/hooks/stop-handoff.sh` extracts the value with:

    val=$(grep "^${key}" "$config" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/.*= *"//' | sed 's/".*//' || true)

## Why it breaks

Both `sed` expressions require a literal double quote. For an *unquoted* TOML
boolean neither substitution matches, so `val` is left as the entire matched
line — `enabled = false` — which compares `!= "false"`, and the hook proceeds as
though it were enabled.

Only the non-idiomatic quoted form `enabled = "false"` actually disables the
hooks.

## Extent

- Affects `post-git.sh` (runs `story sync-git` after every git commit/merge/push)
  and `stop-handoff.sh` (runs `story handoff` on session Stop).
- The unquoted form is exactly what the plugin itself writes: the
  `story-setup` skill's own `plugin-config.toml` template emits
  `enabled = true` / `tracking = "normal"` with no quotes on the boolean.
- So a user who follows the documented instruction to disable the hooks gets no
  effect and no error.

## Repro

    printf '[plugin]\nenabled = false\n' > .storyhook/plugin-config.toml

Then trigger a git commit in a storyhook-initialized repo with the plugin
installed. Expected: post-git hook no-ops. Actual: it runs `story sync-git`
anyway.

## Related

Note a second, latent inconsistency in the same area: this repo's real
`.storyhook/plugin-config.toml` has a `[plugin]` table header, while
`story-setup`'s template writes bare keys with no header. `read_plugin_config`
is table-blind (a plain `grep "^${key}"`), so both happen to work today — but a
real TOML parser would disagree, and the two shapes should be reconciled.

## Fix

Parse the value in a way that tolerates both quoted and unquoted forms, e.g.
strip an optional surrounding quote pair after taking everything past `=` and
trimming whitespace. Add a regression test for `enabled = false`,
`enabled = "false"`, and `enabled = true`, in both the bare-key and
`[plugin]`-table shapes.
